description.zh:
物模型自定义模块标识符，在产品中具有唯一性。

不传入此参数时，导出默认模块数据。
description.en:
The identifier of the custom TSL module. Each identifier is unique in a product.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system exports the data of the default module.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
物模型版本号。

可调用[ListThingModelVersion](~~150318~~)查看产品下的物模型版本号。

为空时返回已发布的最新版本。
description.en:
The version number of the TSL model.

You can call the [ListThingModelVersion](~~150318~~) operation to view the version numbers of the TSL model for a product.

If you do not specify this parameter, the last published TSL version is returned.

description.zh:
资源组ID。

><notice>目前，物联网平台仅支持实例维度的资源组管理。请求参数**ResourceGroupId**配置已无效，无需再传入。
></notice>
description.en:
The resource group ID.

><notice>Currently, IoT Platform supports resource group management only at the instance dimension. The **ResourceGroupId** request parameter is invalid and no longer needs to be passed.
></notice>

title.zh: 导出指定产品物模型扩展描述配置
title.en: Export the Thing Specification Language model extension description configuration of a specified product

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。

   > 单个阿里云账号下的所有RAM用户共享该阿里云账号的配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API is 20 per Alibaba Cloud account.

   > All Resource Access Management (RAM) users under an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of that Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-thing-model-extend-config --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --product-key a1T27vz0000 --resource-group-id 123000 --model-version v1.0.0 --function-block-id BatteryModule --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot QueryThingModelExtendConfig --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000' --ResourceGroupId 123000 --ModelVersion 'v1.0.0' --FunctionBlockId BatteryModule --ProductKey a1T27vz0000
